title: Question 4.1b: Time Measurement Pattern
instruction: This code measures how long an operation takes. Think about why you might want to know how long something takes.
reveal: `System.currentTimeMillis()` returns the current time in milliseconds since January 1, 1970. By recording the time before and after the `.fit()` call, we can calculate how long the training took. This is useful for understanding performance and comparing different approaches. The difference between `startTime` and the time after gives us `trainingTime`.
